const f = (a: number) => String(a);
f.desc = "d";
console.log(f.desc, f(1));
const g = function (a: number) { return a; };
g.count = 0;
g.count++;
console.log(g.count);
type D = { (a: number): number; desc: string };
const h = (a: number) => a;
h.desc = "x";
const d: D = h;
console.log(d.desc, d(3));
function outer() {
  const k = () => 1;
  k.tag = "t";
  return k.tag;
}
console.log(outer());
function e() { return 1; }
e.n = 1;
e.n = "s";
const n1: string = e.n;
const q = <T,>(a: T) => a;
q.r = 1;
console.log(q.r, q("x"), n1);
const s = () => 1;
s["k"] = [1];
s.k.push(2);
function show() { return s.k.length; }
console.log(s.k, show());
const nm = function named() { return 1; };
nm.v = 2;
console.log(nm.v + nm());
